name: Unibet
verdict: Online betting and gaming brand of Kindred Group Ltd., wholly-owned by FDJ UNITED, a company listed on Euronext Paris and controlled by the French State (21.09%). Nothing found.
note: Gambling operator. Kindred was acquired by FDJ UNITED in 2024. The French State keeps close control of FDJ UNITED (21.09%, PACTE law), but France has no record of serious abuses, so it is not a link (METHOD.md: state ownership alone is not a tier). No openable source places Unibet on the 2026-27 OM home shirt.
